ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low; predominant low-intensity (dark grey/black) base surface with high-intensity (white) point-source clusters covering approximately 10-15% of the visible area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Stochastic distribution of high-contrast white pixel blobs across the medial and lateral regions; high concentration of white contiguous pixels forming dense clusters at the distal tips (lobes).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped central depression with a wide angle; depth is approximately 5% of the total vertical height of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration characterized by multiple small peaks and valleys (3-8 pixel amplitude variations) along the entire trailing boundary, with larger indentations visible on the left-side lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lateral concave sweep along the trailing edge transitioning to convex outer margins at the distal extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous localized circular and sub-circular white pixel clusters distributed across the dark field, particularly dense in the sub-terminal regions of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several visible thin, unaligned linear white streaks oriented vertically and diagonally on the medial-left lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular trailing edge serration consistent with tissue degradation or previous trauma; heavy white pixel clustering on tips indicating barnacle colonization or significant scarring.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced white 'tipping' effect where the outermost distal edges are almost entirely comprised of high-intensity pixels compared to the dark interior.
